profile_text.body:
Equifax is a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores to businesses and consumers, according to its website. It also offers identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product it calls Equifax Complete, and says its ID Restoration Specialists work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. Much of the site is educational: it explains how financial behavior affects credit, what appears on credit reports, warning signs of fraud and identity theft, how debt affects credit scores, choosing and managing credit cards, personal finance and saving, and types of loans including personal and student loans. It also publishes Spanish-language material covering Equifax credit reports in the United States, credit scores, and money management advice.

The site text does not describe any artificial intelligence products or services, and no AI products are recorded for the company. Its stated focus is credit reporting, credit monitoring, identity theft protection, and consumer financial education.

Equifax is a for-profit public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX, with CIK 0000033185. Its recorded litigation exposure is concentrated in Georgia, with 105 cases.
